integrity.claim_scope: An exact integral homotopy equivalence for a particular geometric group quotient.
integrity.evidence: Explicit orbit-cell boundary formulas, two standalone exact-integer Smith checks, published shellability, orbit fundamental-group theorem and two-skeleton cofiber argument.

limitations: Only the finite ordinary chessboard complex on four rows and seven columns under even row permutations is classified; this does not assert a general-width formula or independent external proof certification. Unindexed equivalent published mathematics remains possible.
title: Mixed-primary Moore summands in the alternating-row quotient of the first shellable four-row chessboard
